evidence.quote: First, you will need to print off the template for the top piece. You can download this from the “Extras” tab.

R1.reason: The arched crest outline exists only in the downloadable template; viewed step-0 and step-4 images show a traced paper shape and the finished curve but no dimensions. The blank size (1 1/2 x 7 1/4 x 32 cutList[0]) and leg size are given, so a bench can still be built with a self-drawn curve; the vertical/slat lengths are 'cut to fit' the curve. Judged non-blocking (Fix); verifier may judge the crest structural.

R2.reason: Parts cut in steps (top pieces, legs, 2x2 verticals, 2x4 seat supports, 1x2 slats, 1x4 seat slats, arm slats) all map to cutList rows 0-9; searched steps for 'cut' sentences.

R3.reason: All 10 cut rows used: rows 0-1 steps 0/3, rows 2/4 step 6, rows 3/7 steps 5/9/10, rows 5/6 steps 7-8, row 8 step 11, row 9 step 12.

R4.basis: Kreg-corrected cut rows vs board materials (§9)

evidence.quote: You can use 1x2s for this if you don’t have a table saw.

R5.arithmetic: Every part has its stock named in steps. 1x2 need = 12x9 + 8x14.75 + 12x16 = 108 + 118 + 192 = 418" (+ kerf 1/8" x ~32 cuts = 4") vs bought 4 boards x 96" = 384" (materials[4] quantity 4). Short by ~38". Other stocks fit: 2x8 2x32+29.5=93.5 <=96; 2x6 3x29.5=88.5<=96; 2x2 15.5+15.5+19=50<=96; 2x4 2x52+4x16=168<=192; 1x4 4x55=220<=240.
R5.reason: 1x2 stock bought is less than the 1x2 parts require; arm slats need 192" and only 384-226=158" remain after back slats; 1x4 leftovers are ~9" pieces.

R6.reason: Sweep flag '16" nail' is a false positive: step 12 says 'Use long brad nails—at least 2” long', materials[9] '2" or longer brad nails'. 2 1/2", 1 1/4" pocket screws and 1 1/4" exterior screws (materials[8]) all listed; no conflicting sizes.

R10.reason: Back/front support height 16 1/4" from leg bottoms (steps[5], steps[9]); slat gap 'about 1 7/8”' (steps[7]); vertical 2x2 and slat positions shown in viewed step-6/7 images; seat slats 'evenly' and arm slats 'line up' are relational.

R11.reason: Steps that say 'as the picture shows'/'shown' (4, 6, 9, 10) each carry their own step image; step-3 image viewed shows 3"/5"/29 1/2" call-outs.

R8.reason: Crest cut/joined (0-2), legs cut (3), crest attached to back legs (4), back support (5), verticals (6), slats (7-8), then seat supports and slats (9-11), arm slats last (12).

R9.reason: Thickness stated for both stocks: steps[1] 'Drill 1 ½” pocket holes' (2x stock) and steps[8] 'drill ¾” pocket holes' (1x slats).

R14.reason: Counts agree with cut list: 2 outside verticals + middle (steps[6]); 6+6+4+4 back slats = 12 middle + 8 outside (steps[7]); 2x52 + 4x16 2x4 supports (steps 5, 9, 10); 4 seat slats at 55 (step 11); 12 arm slats at 16 (step 12). Every part is installed and the steps end at a finished bench. Step 6 outer verticals '15 1/2' match corrected cutList[2].
